primitives.name: Citation Network Standing
primitives.verbatim_quote: Doreian, "A measure of standing for citation networks within a wider environment,"1994, Inf.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'v': 'node in citation graph, dimensionless', 'N(v)': 'neighbors of v, set of nodes', 'w(u,v)': 'weight of link from u to v, dimensionless', 'Rank(u)': 'rank of node u, dimensionless'}
primitives.assumptions: Graph is directed, weights are non-negative, ranking function is monotonic.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When graph becomes disconnected or weight matrix is singular.

layer2.mapping: Maps to GSI's Bayesian centrality inference where nodes represent documents and edges represent citations.
layer2.telemetry: Document influence score derived from citation count and rank.

primitives.name: Hypertext Hierarchy Metric
primitives.verbatim_quote: Botafogo et al., "Structural analysis of hypertext: Identifying hierarchies and useful metrics," 1992, ACM Trans.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'v': 'node in hypertext graph, dimensionless', 'descendants(v)': 'set of descendant nodes, set of nodes', 'depth(u)': 'depth of node u, integer'}
primitives.assumptions: Graph is acyclic, depth is defined recursively from root.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When graph contains cycles or depth is undefined.

layer2.mapping: Used in GSE for determining navigational priority in structured content.
layer2.telemetry: Average depth of descendants used as proxy for structural importance.

primitives.name: Web Connectivity Search
primitives.verbatim_quote: Carriere et al., "WebQuery: Searching and visualizing the web through connectivity," 1997, Proc.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'q': 'query term, dimensionless', 'V': 'set of web pages, set of nodes', 'LinkStrength(q,v)': 'strength of link from q to v, dimensionless', 'Relevance(v)': 'relevance of page v to q, dimensionless'}
primitives.assumptions: Link strength is normalized, relevance is computed via TF-IDF or similar.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When query is not linked to any page or relevance scores are zero.

layer2.mapping: Maps to GSE's probabilistic pathfinding algorithm using link weights and relevance scores.
layer2.telemetry: Aggregate relevance score per query used for ranking search results.

Dualities emerge between static citation graphs and dynamic hypertext structures, while failure modes include disconnected components and undefined depths.
